papers.venue: ICML 2019 as source-reported comment; exact inspected arXiv version v3 is later
papers.exact_read_scope: Abstract and §§3.1–4.4/Eqs1–14/Algorithm1; inference/learning mechanism only. No proofs/results/pixels/code or full-paper review.
papers.saved_takeaway: Graph label dependencies are learned through a CRF/pseudolikelihood model. A feature GNN approximates mean-field label marginals; another label-input GNN learns local conditionals; variational EM alternates sampled-label learning and target matching.
papers.relationship_to_candidate: Direct graph label-dependency learning prior. GMNN is not the identical four-component product-mixture pair composite likelihood, and its native variational posterior is fully factorized.
papers.attributed_prior_vs_open_gap: Attribute explicit graph label coupling and learned local label conditionals. This primary does not establish the proposed exact ensemble objective or factor-sharing recipe; absence of that exact recipe cannot establish a new principle.
papers.decisive_next_step: No new-method promotion from the pair-loss composition. If pair-learning utility is separately pursued, credit this graph-dependency ancestry and distinguish local conditional/CRF semantics from global finite-mixture pair marginals.
